scope: Exhaustive source declaration inventory in CAD, builders, values/handles, data/geometry, graph, commands, and selected render/repair/print helper namespaces. No target code executed.
methodology: Exhaustive CAD-scope lexical discovery reconciled with Roslyn for all 1,034 qualified type names, class flags, base types and own member/version ownership. Body-based capabilities and explicit gaps are in cad-features.json; declaration counts are not user-feature counts. Static kernel receiver extraction remains lexical.
